alt: Conceptual artwork of helicity-conditioned light interacting with a layered chiral perovskite film; not a measured research figure
caption: Conceptual scientific artwork
question: How can optical helicity be encoded as a persistent, distinguishable electronic memory state?
whatIMeasure: Retained conductance · read-noise-limited state capacity · retention · array response
whyItMatters: An optical input can become a persistent analog state rather than a transient polarization-sensitive response.
findings: A co-first-author Advanced Materials study demonstrated 72 distinguishable conductance states retained for 10⁶ s. A separate read-noise analysis predicted a capacity of 72.3 levels; a 7×7 device array was evaluated for computing.
homeDescription: Optical helicity, persistent analog states, and device-array validation.
